fact: WFP says it is supporting the Commissariat a la Securite Alimentaire in a lessons-learned exercise on the 2025 use of the RSU (Unified Social Registry) for targeting within the national food insecurity response.

WFP says it is financing data collection in 14 chronically food-insecure communes to expand the RSU with an additional 3,000 vulnerable households, and that RSU-based targeting is to be scaled up progressively nationwide.

APIDEV with UNICEF and the Mopti regional social development directorate announces a 30-day household enrolment campaign into the RSU, described as a national system recording households to ease access to social programmes, in named communes of Mopti, Bandiagara and Douentza.
The World Bank SASPP page says its FY26 support will go to implementing the RSU (Unified Social Registry) development plan, finalizing the RSU operational manual and digitalizing historical archives.
